exercises.explain: better 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。

grammar.title: 被动语态：从基本结构到 It 形式主语与高考常见拓展
grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice: Basic Forms, It-structures and Senior-level Extensions
grammar.usage:
被动语态的核心结构是“be + 过去分词”，表示主语是动作的承受者，而不是执行者。根据时态不同，be 的形式会相应变化，例如一般现在时用 am/is/are + done，一般过去时用 was/were + done，现在完成时用 have/has been + done，情态动词后用 be + done。肯定句直接使用该结构；否定句在 be 动词或情态动词后加 not；疑问句把 be 动词或情态动词提到主语前。

初中阶段主要要求掌握一般现在时、一般过去时和含情态动词的被动语态，能够把主动句转换为被动句，并识别动作执行者用 by 引出。高中阶段则进一步要求掌握完成时、进行时以及“It is/was + 过去分词 + that 从句”等高级结构，尤其要理解形式主语 it 的用法。这类结构常用来表达普遍观点、报道、信念等，如 It is said/believed/reported/known that...，其真正主语是后面的 that 从句。

被动语态与主动语态的选择取决于说话人想强调动作的承受者还是执行者。当执行者不明确、不重要或不便提及时，常用被动语态。与“It is + 形容词 + that 从句”结构相比，“It is + 过去分词 + that 从句”更强调动作来源，如“It is believed that...”比“It is likely that...”更具报道性和客观性。此外，部分动词如 say, report, believe, expect, know, think 常用于该结构，且可转换为“sb./sth. + be + 过去分词 + to do”形式，如“He is said to be rich.”。

易错点一：被动语态中 be 动词的时态和主谓一致容易出错，尤其在一般过去时和现在完成时中。易错点二：不及物动词或系动词没有被动语态，如 happen, appear, seem, look, sound 等不能用于被动结构。易错点三：形式主语 it 后的 that 从句不能省略，且从句仍用正常陈述语序。易错点四：主动语态中双宾语的句子变为被动语态时，间接宾语和直接宾语都可作主语，但介词搭配不同，如 give, send, offer 等。
forms: 一般现在时被动：am/is/are + 过去分词
一般过去时被动：was/were + 过去分词
现在完成时被动：have/has been + 过去分词
情态动词被动：情态动词 + be + 过去分词
It is/was + 过去分词 + that 从句（形式主语结构）
主语 + be + 过去分词 + to do（如 He is said to...）
notes: 高考书面语中，It is said/believed/reported that... 比 People say/believe/report that... 更正式、更客观，适合议论文和说明文。
注意被动语态与系表结构的区别：be + 过去分词有时表示状态而非动作，如 The door is closed. 可能是状态，不一定是被动动作。
在高考语法填空和短文改错中，常考被动语态的时态和主谓一致，尤其是完成时被动 have/has been done 与一般过去时被动 was/were done 的区分。
部分动词如 happen, occur, exist, belong to, take place 没有被动语态，不能写成 was happened 或 is belonged to。
形式主语 it 结构中，that 从句不可用 what 或 which 替代，且从句保持陈述语序，不出现倒装。

examples.en: The classroom is cleaned every day by the students.
examples.cn: 教室每天由学生们打扫。

examples.en: The bridge was built in 1998.
examples.cn: 这座桥建于1998年。

examples.en: The homework must be handed in before Friday.
examples.cn: 作业必须在周五之前上交。

examples.en: It is believed that the weather in Britain is unpredictable.
examples.cn: 人们相信英国的天气是不可预测的。

examples.en: It is reported that a new high-speed railway will be completed next year.
examples.cn: 据报道，一条新的高速铁路将于明年建成。

examples.en: The ancient temple is said to have been destroyed in the war.
examples.cn: 据说这座古庙在战争中被毁坏了。

exercises.q: The classroom ______ every day by the students.
exercises.explain: 一般现在时的被动语态用 am/is/are + 过去分词，主语 classroom 是动作的承受者。

exercises.q: English ______ in many countries around the world.
exercises.explain: English 是"被说"，用一般现在时被动语态 is + spoken。

exercises.q: The cake ______ by my mother yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 提示一般过去时，被动语态用 was/were + 过去分词。

exercises.q: These books ______ to the library last week.
exercises.explain: 主语 books 是复数且时间为 last week，用 were + returned。

exercises.q: The windows ______ by Tom every morning.
exercises.explain: windows 是复数，一般现在时被动语态用 are + opened。

exercises.q: The room ______ (clean) every day.
exercises.explain: every day 提示一般现在时，room 作主语用被动语态 is cleaned。

exercises.q: The letter ______ (write) by Lucy yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 提示一般过去时，letter 作主语用 was written。

exercises.q: These trees ______ (plant) by the students last spring.
exercises.explain: last spring 提示过去时，trees 是复数，用 were planted。

exercises.q: The sentence "The homework is finished by Tom every day." is in passive voice.
exercises.explain: is finished 是 be + 过去分词结构，表示被动语态。

exercises.q: The sentence "My mother cleans the room every day." is in passive voice.
exercises.explain: 该句是主动语态，主语 My mother 是动作执行者。

exercises.q: Tom cleans the blackboard every day. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The blackboard is cleaned by Tom every day.
exercises.explain: 主动句宾语变被动句主语，动词用 is cleaned，by 引出执行者。

exercises.q: The song was sung by Mary. (改为主动语态)
exercises.explain: 被动句中的 by Mary 变主动句主语，was sung 还原为过去式 sang。

exercises.q: They make cars in this factory. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: Cars are made in this factory.
exercises.explain: 宾语 cars 变主语，一般现在时被动用 are made。

exercises.q: The room is clean by Tom every day.
exercises.answer: The room is cleaned by Tom every day.
exercises.explain: 被动语态需要过去分词 cleaned，clean 是动词原形。

exercises.q: The letters was written by Lucy yesterday.
exercises.answer: The letters were written by Lucy yesterday.
exercises.explain: 主语 letters 是复数，be 动词应用 were 而非 was。

exercises.q: The new bridge ______ in 2020.
exercises.explain: in 2020 是过去时间，bridge 作主语用一般过去时被动语态 was built。

exercises.q: A lot of trees ______ on the hill every year.
exercises.explain: every year 提示一般现在时，trees 是复数，用 are planted。

exercises.q: The work ______ by the time the teacher came in.
exercises.explain: by the time + 过去时表示"到那时已经完成"，用过去完成时被动 had been finished。

exercises.q: This kind of phone ______ in China.
exercises.explain: phone 是"被制造"，用一般现在时被动语态 is made。

exercises.q: The classroom must ______ clean and tidy.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 must 后接动词原形，被动语态用 be + 过去分词 kept。

exercises.q: The classroom should ______ (keep) clean every day.
exercises.explain: should 后接动词原形，被动语态用 be kept。

exercises.q: The old building ______ (pull) down last month.
exercises.explain: last month 提示过去时，building 作主语用 was pulled。

exercises.q: The homework ______ (must finish) before Friday.
exercises.explain: must 后接 be + 过去分词，表示"必须被完成"。

exercises.q: The sentence "The book was written by Lu Xun." means Lu Xun wrote the book.
exercises.explain: by Lu Xun 表明动作执行者是鲁迅，与主动句意思相同。

exercises.q: In the sentence "The window was broken by the boy", the window is the doer of the action.
exercises.explain: the window 是动作的承受者，the boy 才是执行者。

exercises.q: People speak English in many countries. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: English is spoken in many countries.
exercises.explain: 宾语 English 变主语，一般现在时被动用 is spoken。

exercises.q: The letter was sent by Tom yesterday. (改为主动语态)
exercises.explain: by Tom 变主语，was sent 还原为过去式 sent。

exercises.q: We should water the flowers every day. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The flowers should be watered every day.
exercises.explain: should 后接 be + 过去分词 watered，宾语变主语。

exercises.q: The homework must finished before Friday.
exercises.answer: The homework must be finished before Friday.
exercises.explain: must 后需接 be + 过去分词构成被动语态。

exercises.q: A new school is build in our town now.
exercises.answer: A new school is being built in our town now.
exercises.explain: now 提示现在进行时，被动语态用 is being built。

exercises.q: It is said that a new subway ______ in our city next year.
exercises.explain: next year 提示将来时，subway 作主语用 will be built。

exercises.q: The problem ______ at the meeting yesterday, but no agreement was reached.
exercises.explain: yesterday 提示过去时，problem 作主语用 was discussed。

exercises.q: The children ______ not to play in the street by their parents.
exercises.explain: children 是"被告知"，用一般现在时被动 are told。

exercises.q: By the end of last year, over 1000 books ______ to the village school.
exercises.explain: by the end of last year 提示过去完成时，books 作主语用 had been sent。

exercises.q: The old man ______ to hospital at once after the accident.
exercises.explain: 事故发生在过去，old man 是"被送往"，用 was taken。

exercises.q: The meeting ______ (hold) in the hall next Monday.
exercises.explain: next Monday 提示将来时，meeting 作主语用 will be held。

exercises.q: The novel ______ (translate) into many languages since it was published.
exercises.explain: since 提示现在完成时，novel 作主语用 has been translated。

exercises.q: The windows ______ (clean) when I arrived at the school.
exercises.explain: when I arrived 提示过去进行时，windows 作主语用 were being cleaned。

exercises.q: The sentence "It is believed that the team will win the game." can be rewritten as "People believe that the team will win the game."
exercises.explain: It is believed that... 相当于 People believe that...，两者意思相同。

exercises.q: In the sentence "The house was built in 1990", the exact builder is clearly stated.
exercises.explain: 该句未提及建造者，被动语态省略了执行者。

exercises.q: They will finish the project next month. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The project will be finished next month.
exercises.explain: 宾语 project 变主语，将来时被动用 will be finished。

exercises.q: The report has been written by the manager. (改为主动语态)
exercises.answer: The manager has written the report.
exercises.explain: by the manager 变主语，has been written 还原为 has written。

exercises.q: People say that the new policy will be carried out soon. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: It is said that the new policy will be carried out soon.
exercises.explain: People say that... 可转换为 It is said that... 的被动结构。

exercises.q: The new library has built in our school since last year.
exercises.answer: The new library has been built in our school since last year.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时被动语态需用 has been built，而非 has built。

exercises.q: The children are made do their homework before dinner.
exercises.answer: The children are made to do their homework before dinner.
exercises.explain: make 在被动语态中需接带 to 的不定式，即 be made to do。

exercises.q: The classroom ______ every day after school.
exercises.explain: 主语 classroom 是动作的承受者，需用一般现在时被动语态 is cleaned。

exercises.q: These photos ______ by my father last summer.
exercises.explain: last summer 提示过去时，photos 作主语需用 were taken。

exercises.q: English ______ in many countries around the world.
exercises.explain: English 是 speak 的承受者，用一般现在时被动语态 is spoken。

exercises.q: The window ______ by Tom yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 提示过去时，window 作主语需用 was broken。

exercises.q: A new library ______ in our school next year.
exercises.explain: next year 提示将来时，library 作主语需用 will be built。

exercises.q: The homework ______ (do) by the students every evening.
exercises.explain: every evening 提示一般现在时，homework 作主语用 is done。

exercises.q: The trees ______ (plant) by the students last spring.
exercises.explain: last spring 提示过去时，trees 作主语用 were planted。

exercises.q: This song ______ (sing) by many people every day.
exercises.explain: every day 提示一般现在时，song 作主语用 is sung。

exercises.q: The book was wrote by a famous writer.
exercises.explain: write 的过去分词是 written，不是 wrote。

exercises.q: The cake is made by my mother every week.
exercises.explain: 一般现在时被动语态 is made 使用正确。

exercises.q: People speak English in Australia. (改为被动语态)
exercises.explain: 主动语态转被动语态，宾语 English 变主语，动词用 is spoken。

exercises.q: The room is cleaned by the students. (改为主动语态)
exercises.explain: 被动语态转主动语态，by 后的执行者变主语，动词用 clean。

exercises.q: They built the bridge in 2000. (改为被动语态)
exercises.explain: 过去时主动转被动，宾语 bridge 变主语，动词用 was built。

exercises.q: The letters are send by the postman every morning.
exercises.answer: The letters are sent by the postman every morning.
exercises.explain: send 的过去分词是 sent，被动语态需用 are sent。

exercises.q: The car was repair by my uncle yesterday.
exercises.answer: The car was repaired by my uncle yesterday.
exercises.explain: repair 的过去分词是 repaired，被动语态需用 was repaired。

exercises.q: The new shopping mall ______ next month.
exercises.explain: next month 提示将来时，mall 作主语需用 will be opened。

exercises.q: This kind of phone ______ very well in the market.
exercises.explain: sell 表示产品销路好时用主动形式表被动含义。

exercises.q: The report ______ by the manager before the meeting started.
exercises.explain: before the meeting started 提示过去完成时，report 作主语用 had been finished。

exercises.q: A lot of trees ______ along the river since 2020.
exercises.explain: since 2020 提示现在完成时，trees 作主语用 have been planted。

exercises.q: The problem ______ at the meeting tomorrow.
exercises.explain: tomorrow 提示将来时，problem 作主语需用 will be discussed。

exercises.q: The project ______ (complete) by the end of last month.
exercises.explain: by the end of last month 提示过去完成时，project 作主语用 had been completed。

exercises.q: The old building ______ (pull) down next week.
exercises.explain: next week 提示将来时，building 作主语用 will be pulled。

exercises.q: The letter ______ (write) in English by the secretary now.
exercises.explain: now 提示现在进行时，letter 作主语用 is being written。

exercises.q: The homework has been finished by the students already.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时被动语态 has been finished 使用正确。

exercises.q: The meeting was held by the manager last week.
exercises.explain: 过去时被动语态 was held 使用正确。

exercises.q: They are building a new hospital in the city center. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: A new hospital is being built in the city center.
exercises.explain: 现在进行时主动转被动，宾语 hospital 变主语，动词用 is being built。

exercises.q: The novel was written by a young writer. (改为主动语态)
exercises.answer: A young writer wrote the novel.
exercises.explain: 被动语态转主动语态，by 后的执行者变主语，动词用 wrote。

exercises.q: People say that the new policy will be carried out soon. (用 It is said 改写)
exercises.answer: It is said that the new policy will be carried out soon.
exercises.explain: It is said that 句型用于表达普遍说法，主语 It 为形式主语。

exercises.q: The new bridge has been build by the workers.
exercises.answer: The new bridge has been built by the workers.
exercises.explain: build 的过去分词是 built，现在完成时被动语态需用 has been built。

exercises.q: The dishes are being wash by my sister now.
exercises.answer: The dishes are being washed by my sister now.
exercises.explain: 现在进行时被动语态需用 being washed，wash 的过去分词是 washed。

exercises.q: It is believed that the ancient city ______ by an earthquake around 2000 years ago.
exercises.explain: around 2000 years ago 提示过去时，city 作主语用 was destroyed。

exercises.q: The proposal ______ by the committee before it was put into practice.
exercises.explain: before it was put into practice 提示过去完成时，proposal 作主语用 had been approved。

exercises.q: The new software ______ to be more efficient than the previous version.
exercises.explain: software 是 claim 的承受者，用一般现在时被动语态 is claimed。

exercises.q: The results of the experiment ______ by the research team at the moment.
exercises.explain: at the moment 提示现在进行时，results 作主语用 are being analyzed。

exercises.q: It ______ that the company will expand its business overseas next year.
exercises.explain: It is reported that 句型中 It 为形式主语，用被动语态 is reported。

exercises.q: The ancient manuscript ______ (preserve) in the museum for over a century.
exercises.explain: for over a century 提示现在完成时，manuscript 作主语用 has been preserved。

exercises.q: The new policy ______ (implement) by the government since last year.
exercises.explain: since last year 提示现在完成时，policy 作主语用 has been implemented。

exercises.q: The building ______ (renovate) when the fire broke out.
exercises.explain: when the fire broke out 提示过去进行时，building 作主语用 was being renovated。

exercises.q: It is said that the ancient temple was built over 1000 years ago.
exercises.explain: It is said that 句型与过去时被动语态 was built 搭配正确。

exercises.q: The data has been collected by the researchers since last month.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时被动语态 has been collected 与 since last month 搭配正确。

exercises.q: People believe that the new medicine can cure the disease. (用 It is believed 改写)
exercises.answer: It is believed that the new medicine can cure the disease.
exercises.explain: It is believed that 句型用于表达普遍观点，主语 It 为形式主语。

exercises.q: The committee has approved the new budget. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The new budget has been approved by the committee.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时主动转被动，宾语 budget 变主语，动词用 has been approved。

exercises.q: The novel was being written by the author when he died. (改为主动语态)
exercises.answer: The author was writing the novel when he died.
exercises.explain: 过去进行时被动转主动，by 后的执行者变主语，动词用 was writing。

exercises.q: The new regulations have been put into effect by the government last year.
exercises.answer: The new regulations were put into effect by the government last year.
exercises.explain: last year 提示过去时，不能用现在完成时，需改为 were put。

exercises.q: It is said that the ancient city was being discovered by archaeologists in 1920.
exercises.answer: It is said that the ancient city was discovered by archaeologists in 1920.
exercises.explain: in 1920 提示过去时，不能用过去进行时，需改为 was discovered。

grammar.key: Adverbial Clause of Result / 结果状语从句
grammar.title: 结果状语从句：so...that / such...that 及其拓展（含 so that 与 too...to / enough...to 转换）
grammar.titleEn: Adverbial Clause of Result: so...that, such...that and Related Structures
grammar.usage:
结果状语从句用于说明主句动作或状态所导致的结果，最常见的结构是“so + 形容词/副词 + that + 从句”和“such + 名词短语 + that + 从句”，表示“如此……以至于……”。其中 so 修饰形容词或副词，such 修饰名词或名词短语。肯定句中 that 从句说明实际发生的结果；否定句中常表示某种程度不足以实现某事，如“so...that...can't/couldn't...”。疑问句和否定主句同样可以带结果状语从句，例如“Is he so tired that he can't continue?”或“It wasn't so cold that we had to stay inside.”。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 so...that 和 such...that 的基本区别，以及 so + 形容词/副词、such + a/an + 形容词 + 可数名词单数、such + 形容词 + 不可数名词/复数名词这三种常见搭配。高中阶段则进一步要求：第一，能在书面表达中灵活使用 so...that 与 such...that 进行句型转换；第二，理解 so that 既可引导目的状语从句也可引导结果状语从句，并能根据语境判断；第三，掌握 so...that 与 too...to...、enough...to... 之间的同义转换；第四，注意 so 位于句首时的倒装结构，如“So fast did he speak that I couldn't understand him.”，这是高考书面语和阅读中的高级语法现象。

与近义结构对比：so...that 强调程度与结果，such...that 同样强调程度与结果但后面接名词短语；so that 引导结果从句时前面通常有逗号，表示“因此/所以”，引导目的从句时常含情态动词 can/could/may/might，表示“以便/为了”；too...to... 表示“太……而不能……”，本身已含否定含义；enough...to... 表示“足够……可以……”，用于肯定意义。在高考书面表达中，适当使用 so...that 和 such...that 能增强句式的丰富性，但要注意避免与 so that 混淆。

易错点：一是 so 和 such 的误用，如“so beautiful a girl”与“such a beautiful girl”均可，但“so a beautiful girl”错误；二是 that 在口语中可省略，但在高考书面表达和语法填空中通常要求保留；三是 so...that 与 too...to 转换时，要注意主从句主语是否一致，不一致时需用 for sb. to do 结构；四是 so 位于句首的倒装结构在高考阅读和完形中偶有出现，需能识别其含义。
forms: so + 形容词/副词 + that + 从句
such + a/an + 形容词 + 可数名词单数 + that + 从句
such + 形容词 + 不可数名词/复数名词 + that + 从句
so + 形容词 + a/an + 可数名词单数 + that + 从句（书面语/正式语体）
so + many/few + 复数名词 + that + 从句；so + much/little + 不可数名词 + that + 从句
So + 形容词/副词 + 助动词/be动词 + 主语 + that + 从句（倒装结构，高考书面语）
notes: so 后面接形容词或副词，such 后面接名词短语；但“so + 形容词 + a/an + 单数名词”是书面语中的正式用法，高考阅读中可能出现。
so...that 与 such...that 转换时，注意名词的可数性：such a difficult problem = so difficult a problem，但 such difficult problems 不能写成 so difficult problems。
so that 引导结果状语从句时，前面常有逗号，且从句中通常不含情态动词；引导目的状语从句时，从句中常出现 can/could/may/might。高考语法填空需根据语境判断。
so...that...can't/couldn't... 可转换为 too...to...，但需注意主语一致性；主语不一致时用 too...for sb. to do...，如“The box is so heavy that I can't carry it.” = “The box is too heavy for me to carry.”
so 位于句首时，主句要用部分倒装，如“So quickly did he run that nobody could catch him.”，这是高考书面语和阅读中的高级语法现象，写作中可适当使用以提升文采。

examples.cn: 说明如此令人困惑，以至于好几位顾客犯了同样的错误。

examples.cn: 科技发展得如此迅速，以至于许多传统工作已经消失。

examples.cn: 证据如此确凿，以至于委员会别无选择，只能展开全面调查。

grammar.key: Adverbial Clause of Reason / 原因状语从句
grammar.title: 原因状语从句：because / since / as / for 的用法与辨析
grammar.titleEn: Adverbial Clause of Reason: because, since, as, for
grammar.usage:
原因状语从句用于说明主句动作或状态发生的原因，回答“为什么”的问题。最核心的结构是“主句 + because + 原因从句”，because 表示直接、强烈的因果关系，是四个常见原因连词中语气最强的。肯定句中，because 从句通常放在主句之后；若将 because 从句置于句首，需要用逗号与主句隔开。否定形式有两种情况：一是主句否定，如 I didn't go because I was ill；二是对原因本身进行否定，如 I didn't go because I was ill but because I was tired，此时需要借助上下文或对比结构来明确否定范围。疑问句中，because 从句常用来回答 why 引导的特殊疑问句，也可出现在一般疑问句的答语中，如 —Why was he late? —Because he missed the bus。

在近义结构对比上，because 表示直接的、未知的或强调的原因，语气最强；since 表示“既然”，通常指双方已知的原因，语气较弱，多置于句首；as 表示“由于”，语气更弱，多用于日常口语和非正式书面语，常放在句首；for 是并列连词，连接两个并列分句，表示补充说明或推断性原因，语气最弱，多用于正式书面语，且不能放在句首。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 because 的基本用法，能回答 why 问句，并知道 because 不能与 so 连用。高中阶段则要求进一步辨析 because、since、as、for 的语域和语气差异，能在书面表达中根据语境选择恰当的连词，并掌握 because 引导的表语从句（如 It is because...）以及 because of 与 because 的转换。此外，高中还需注意 because 从句在强调句中的使用，如 It was because of the rain that we stayed at home。

易错点包括：because 与 so 不能在同一句中同时使用；because 后接从句，because of 后接名词或动名词，两者不可混用；for 作为并列连词不能置于句首引导原因；since 和 as 引导原因时，不能用于回答 why 的提问，只有 because 可以。
forms: 主句 + because + 原因从句（肯定式）
Because + 原因从句, + 主句（从句前置，需加逗号）
主句 + not... because...（否定主句，原因从句为肯定）
主句 + not because... but because...（否定一个原因，肯定另一个原因）
Since / As + 原因从句, + 主句（已知原因或弱语气原因）
主句 + for + 并列分句（补充说明原因，正式书面语）
It is because + 原因从句（because 引导表语从句）
notes: because 和 so 不能在同一句中连用，这是高考短文改错和语法填空的高频考点。
because 后接从句，because of 后接名词、代词或动名词，书面表达中混用会扣分。
for 是并列连词，不能放在句首引导原因，且多用于正式书面语，口语中使用会显得生硬。
since 和 as 引导的原因通常是已知信息，不能用来回答 why 的提问；高考阅读中常据此判断语境。
在强调句 It was because... that... 中，because 从句被强调时，不能换成 since 或 as，这是高考语法填空的难点。

examples.en: I stayed at home because it rained heavily.
examples.cn: 我待在家里，因为雨下得很大。

examples.en: Because the weather was bad, we put off the picnic.
examples.cn: 因为天气不好，我们推迟了野餐。

examples.en: Since everyone is here, let's begin the meeting.
examples.cn: 既然大家都到齐了，我们开始开会吧。

examples.en: He didn't go to school not because he was ill but because he had to look after his sister.
examples.cn: 他没去上学不是因为他生病了，而是因为他得照顾妹妹。

examples.en: As the deadline was approaching, the team worked overtime to finish the project.
examples.cn: 由于截止日期临近，团队加班加点完成项目。

examples.en: The evidence is unreliable, for the witness has contradicted himself several times.
examples.cn: 该证据不可靠，因为证人已多次自相矛盾。

exercises.q: I stayed at home ______ it rained heavily.
exercises.explain: because 引导原因状语从句，说明待在家里的原因。

exercises.q: ______ she was tired, she went to bed early.
exercises.explain: 句首用 Because 引导原因状语从句，表示她早睡的原因。

exercises.q: We didn't go to the park ______ the weather was bad.
exercises.explain: because 连接主句和原因从句，说明没去公园的原因。

exercises.q: He likes English ______ it is interesting.
exercises.explain: because 引导原因从句，解释他喜欢英语的原因。

exercises.q: ______ he was late, he ran to school.
exercises.explain: 句首 Because 引导原因状语从句，说明他跑着去学校的原因。

exercises.q: I am hungry ______ I didn't have breakfast.
exercises.explain: because 引导原因状语从句，说明饿的原因。

exercises.q: ______ it was cold, she wore a coat.
exercises.explain: 句首用 Because 引导原因状语从句，表示穿外套的原因。

exercises.q: They didn't swim ______ the water was too cold.
exercises.explain: because 引导原因从句，说明没有游泳的原因。

exercises.q: The sentence "I stayed home because it rained." means the rain was the reason I stayed home.
exercises.explain: because 引导的原因状语从句表示下雨是待在家里的原因。

exercises.q: In the sentence "Because he was sick, he went to school.", the reason clause is used correctly.
exercises.explain: 生病与上学逻辑矛盾，原因与结果不匹配。

exercises.q: I was late. I missed the bus. (用 because 合并句子)
exercises.answer: I was late because I missed the bus.
exercises.explain: 用 because 连接两个句子，后句说明前句的原因。

exercises.q: She is happy. She got a gift. (用 because 合并句子)
exercises.answer: She is happy because she got a gift.
exercises.explain: because 引导原因状语从句，说明她开心的原因。

exercises.q: We stayed inside. It was too hot. (用 because 合并句子)
exercises.answer: We stayed inside because it was too hot.
exercises.explain: 用 because 连接主句和原因从句，说明待在室内的原因。

exercises.q: He didn't come to school because he was ill, so he stayed at home.
exercises.answer: He didn't come to school because he was ill.
exercises.explain: because 和 so 不能在同一句中连用，应删去其中一个。

exercises.q: Because it was raining, so we took an umbrella.
exercises.answer: Because it was raining, we took an umbrella.
exercises.explain: because 与 so 不能同时使用，去掉 so 即可。

exercises.q: ______ you are free, let's go shopping.
exercises.explain: since 表示已知原因，语气较弱，常置于句首。

exercises.q: He didn't hear the phone ______ he was listening to music.
exercises.explain: because 语气最强，直接说明没听到电话的原因。

exercises.q: ______ it was late, we decided to go home.
exercises.explain: as 表示原因，语气较弱，多用于口语，常置于句首。

exercises.q: The ground is wet, ______ it rained last night.
exercises.explain: for 是并列连词，表示推断性原因，对前句作补充说明。

exercises.q: ______ everyone is here, let's start the meeting.
exercises.explain: since 表示大家都知道的已知原因，语气较弱。

exercises.q: ______ you don't feel well, you should see a doctor.
exercises.explain: since 引导原因状语从句，表示已知原因，语气较弱。

exercises.q: He was punished ______ he broke the window.
exercises.explain: because 直接说明受罚的原因，语气最强。

exercises.q: ______ it was getting dark, we hurried home.
exercises.explain: as 引导原因状语从句，表示时间伴随的原因，语气较弱。

exercises.q: The sentence "Since you are tired, you should rest." means the speaker is giving a reason that both people already know.
exercises.explain: since 表示已知原因，双方都清楚的事实。

exercises.q: In the sentence "He is late for school because he missed the bus.", "because" can be replaced by "so" without changing the meaning.
exercises.explain: because 表示原因，so 表示结果，不能互换。

exercises.q: He can't play basketball because he hurt his leg. (用 be able to 改写)
exercises.answer: He isn't able to play basketball because he hurt his leg.
exercises.explain: can't 可改写为 isn't able to，保持原因状语从句不变。

exercises.q: She didn't go to the party. She was busy. (用 since 合并句子)
exercises.answer: She didn't go to the party since she was busy.
exercises.explain: since 引导原因状语从句，表示已知原因。

exercises.q: The match was cancelled. It rained heavily. (用 as 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The match was cancelled as it rained heavily.
exercises.explain: as 引导原因状语从句，语气较弱，表示原因。

exercises.q: Because he was very tired, so he went to bed early.
exercises.answer: Because he was very tired, he went to bed early.
exercises.explain: because 和 so 不能连用，应删去 so。

exercises.q: For it was raining, we stayed at home.
exercises.answer: Because it was raining, we stayed at home.
exercises.explain: for 是并列连词，不用于句首引导原因从句，应改为 because。

exercises.q: It was ______ he was ill that he didn't attend the meeting.
exercises.explain: 强调句型 It was...that... 中只能用 because 引导原因。

exercises.q: ______ you have finished your homework, you can watch TV.
exercises.explain: now that 表示既然，引导原因状语从句，相当于 since。

exercises.q: He must have passed the exam, ______ he looks so happy.
exercises.explain: for 表示推断性原因，对前面的推测作补充说明。

exercises.q: ______ the weather was terrible, the outdoor concert was postponed.
exercises.explain: owing to the fact that 后接从句，表示原因，相当于 because。

exercises.q: The reason ______ he was absent was that he was sick.
exercises.explain: the reason why... 是固定搭配，why 引导定语从句修饰 reason。

exercises.q: ______ that you are here, we can begin the discussion.
exercises.explain: now that 引导原因状语从句，表示既然。

exercises.q: He was praised ______ he had helped the old man.
exercises.explain: because 引导原因状语从句，说明被表扬的原因。

exercises.q: ______ it was getting late, they decided to stop working.
exercises.explain: seeing that 引导原因状语从句，表示鉴于、由于。

exercises.q: The sentence "It was because of the heavy rain that the match was put off." uses an emphatic structure with "because of".
exercises.explain: It was...that... 强调句型中可以用 because of 短语强调原因。

exercises.q: In the sentence "The reason why he failed was because he didn't work hard.", the use of "because" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: the reason why... 后的表语从句应用 that 引导，不能用 because。

exercises.q: He didn't come to the party because he had to work. (用 the reason why 改写)
exercises.answer: The reason why he didn't come to the party was that he had to work.
exercises.explain: 用 the reason why...was that... 结构改写原因状语从句。

exercises.q: She was late because the traffic was heavy. (用 because of 改写)
exercises.answer: She was late because of the heavy traffic.
exercises.explain: because 引导从句可改写为 because of 加名词短语。

exercises.q: Since you are tired, you should take a break. (用 now that 改写)
exercises.answer: Now that you are tired, you should take a break.
exercises.explain: now that 与 since 同义，可替换引导原因状语从句。

exercises.q: The reason why he was late was because he missed the bus.
exercises.answer: The reason why he was late was that he missed the bus.
exercises.explain: the reason why... 后的表语从句应用 that 引导，不能用 because。

exercises.answer: Because he didn't study hard, he failed the exam.
exercises.explain: because 与 so 不能同时使用，应删去 so。

exercises.q: ______ you are tired, you should go to bed early.
exercises.explain: since 表示“既然”，常置于句首，语气比 because 弱。

exercises.explain: because 直接引出“没来上学”的原因。

exercises.q: ______ it was late, we decided to take a taxi.
exercises.explain: as 表示“由于”，语气较弱，多用于口语。

exercises.explain: because 引导原因状语从句，说明不去公园的原因。

exercises.q: She was late ______ she missed the bus.
exercises.explain: because 引导原因状语从句，解释迟到的原因。

exercises.q: ______ you are here, we can start the meeting.
exercises.explain: since 表示“既然”，引导已知原因，常置于句首。

exercises.q: I can't buy this book ______ I have no money.
exercises.explain: because 直接说明无法买书的原因。

exercises.q: Because it was raining, so we stayed at home.
exercises.explain: because 和 so 不能在同一句子中连用，这是常见错误。

exercises.q: Since you don't like it, I will not buy it.
exercises.explain: since 引导原因状语从句，表示“既然”，用法正确。

exercises.q: He was late because he got up late. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: He was not late because he got up late.
exercises.explain: 否定主句谓语，because 从句保持不变。

exercises.q: She is happy because she passed the exam. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Is she happy because she passed the exam?
exercises.explain: 将 be 动词提前构成一般疑问句，because 从句不变。

exercises.q: I stayed at home because it rained. (用 since 改写)
exercises.answer: Since it rained, I stayed at home.
exercises.explain: since 可替换 because，常置于句首表示原因。

exercises.q: Because he was tired, so he went to bed early.
exercises.answer: Because he was tired, he went to bed early.

exercises.q: ______ he had a bad cold, he stayed in bed all day.

exercises.q: Since you are busy, I will go alone. (改为 because 开头)
exercises.answer: Because you are busy, I will go alone.

exercises.answer: He couldn't sleep not because the noise was too loud.

exercises.q: He didn't come to the party because he had to work, so he was tired.
exercises.answer: He didn't come to the party because he had to work.

exercises.q: The project was delayed, ______ several key members were absent.

exercises.q: The company's profits fell sharply ______ the economic recession.

exercises.q: For he was ill, he didn't attend the meeting.

exercises.q: He was unable to attend the conference because he was ill. (改为同义句，用 due to)
exercises.answer: He was unable to attend the conference due to his illness.
exercises.explain: due to 后接名词短语，需将从句改为名词形式。

exercises.q: Since the data was incomplete, the analysis was flawed. (改为 because 开头)
exercises.answer: Because the data was incomplete, the analysis was flawed.
exercises.explain: because 可替换 since，语气更强。

exercises.q: She didn't accept the offer because the salary was too low. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: She didn't accept the offer not because the salary was too low.
exercises.explain: 否定主句谓语，because 从句不变。

exercises.q: Because of the fact that he was late, so he missed the beginning of the speech.
exercises.answer: Because he was late, he missed the beginning of the speech.
exercises.explain: because of the fact that 冗余，且 because 和 so 不能连用。

exercises.q: He didn't get the job because he lacked experience, for he was not qualified.
exercises.answer: He didn't get the job because he lacked experience.
exercises.explain: because 和 for 重复表示原因，删去 for 部分。

grammar.key: Adverbial Clause of Condition / 条件状语从句
grammar.title: 条件状语从句：if / unless / as long as / in case 及主将从现
grammar.titleEn: Adverbial Clause of Condition: if, unless, as long as, in case and the present-for-future rule
grammar.usage:
条件状语从句用来表示“在……条件下，主句的情况才会发生”。最常用的引导词是 if，此外高中阶段还应掌握 unless（除非）、as long as / so long as（只要）、in case（以防/如果）、provided/providing that（假如）、suppose/supposing that（假设）等。核心结构是：条件从句 + 主句。条件从句可放在主句前，也可放在主句后；放在主句前时，从句后通常加逗号。

肯定式：If you work hard, you will make progress. 否定式：If you don't hurry, you will miss the train. 疑问式：What will you do if it rains tomorrow? 条件从句本身通常不用将来时，而用一般现在时表示将来，这就是常说的“主将从现”。主句除了一般将来时，还常用 can / may / might / could / should 等情态动词，或祈使句。

与近义结构对比：unless 相当于 if...not，但语气更强，常用于“如果不……就不会……”的语境；as long as 强调“只要满足这个条件就足够”；in case 侧重“以防某种情况发生”，常与 should 或一般现在时连用；provided/providing that 多用于书面语或正式文体，表示“在……前提下”。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 if 引导的条件句和“主将从现”的基本规则，以及 if 与 unless 的简单转换。高中阶段则进一步要求：区分 if 引导条件状语从句与 if 引导宾语从句（意为“是否”）；掌握 as long as、in case、provided that 等更多引导词；理解真实条件句与非真实条件句（虚拟语气）的区别；在书面表达中能根据语域选择恰当的引导词。

易错点：1. 在 if 条件从句中误用 will，如 If it will rain 是错误的，应改为 If it rains。2. 混淆 if 引导条件状语从句和宾语从句：I don't know if he will come 中的 if 意为“是否”，从句可以用将来时。3. unless 与 if...not 并非在所有语境下都能完全互换，当主句本身是否定句时，unless 可能造成逻辑混乱。4. in case 引导的从句在英式英语中常用 should do，在美式英语中常用一般现在时，但都不用将来时。
forms: If + 一般现在时，主句 + will/can/may/might + 动词原形
If + 一般现在时，祈使句
Unless + 一般现在时，主句 + will/can + 动词原形
As long as + 一般现在时，主句 + will/can + 动词原形
In case + 一般现在时/should do，主句 + will/can + 动词原形
Provided/Providing (that) + 一般现在时，主句 + will/can + 动词原形
notes: 条件状语从句中不用 will 表示将来，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点。
if 引导宾语从句时意为“是否”，从句时态根据实际情况变化，不要与条件状语从句混淆。
unless 在书面语中比 if...not 更正式，但在主句为否定句时慎用，避免双重否定造成歧义。
provided that 和 providing that 多用于正式书面语，口语中较少使用，高考书面表达中可适当使用以提升语域。
in case 引导的从句在英式英语中常用 should do 表示“万一”，在美式英语中多用一般现在时，两种用法在阅读中都可能出现。

grammar.title: 比较结构：as…as / not as…as 及其与比较级、最高级的拓展
grammar.titleEn: Comparative Structures: as…as, not as/so…as, and Related Comparative Forms
grammar.usage:
比较结构用于说明两个人、事物或动作在某方面程度的异同。最核心的同级比较结构是“as + 形容词/副词原级 + as”，表示“和……一样……”，例如“as warm as spring”意为“温暖如春”。其否定形式为“not as + 形容词/副词原级 + as”或“not so + 形容词/副词原级 + as”，表示“不如……那样……”。在疑问句中，通常将第一个 as 前的 be 动词、助动词或情态动词提前，例如“Is this winter as cold as last winter?”。

同级比较结构常与比较级、最高级形成对比。比较级用“形容词/副词比较级 + than”表示“比……更……”，最高级用“the + 形容词/副词最高级 + 比较范围”表示“在……中最……”。三者并非孤立存在：同一语义可以用不同结构表达，例如“This winter is not as cold as last winter.”可以改写为“Last winter was colder than this winter.”，但语气和侧重点略有不同。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 as…as 与 not as/so…as 的基本形式，以及规则形容词、副词比较级和最高级的构成。高中阶段则进一步要求：1）在复杂句和书面语中灵活使用比较结构；2）掌握“as + 形容词 + a/an + 可数名词单数 + as”等高级结构；3）理解“倍数 + as…as”表示倍数关系；4）注意比较对象在逻辑上的一致性，避免比较对象不对等；5）在阅读和写作中识别并运用“the + 比较级, the + 比较级”等特殊比较句式。

易错点一：as…as 中间误用比较级或最高级。该结构中间必须用形容词或副词的原级，不能说“as warmer as”。易错点二：否定形式中 so 与 as 的混用。not so…as 多用于口语和部分书面语，not as…as 在正式书面语中更常见，两者均可接受，但需保持前后一致。易错点三：比较对象不对等。例如“The weather in Beijing is colder than Shanghai”是错误的，应改为“The weather in Beijing is colder than that in Shanghai”。易错点四：忽略不规则形容词和副词的比较等级变化，如 good/well—better—best，bad/badly—worse—worst，many/much—more—most，little—less—least，far—farther/further—farthest/furthest。
forms: 肯定同级比较：A + be/动词 + as + 形容词/副词原级 + as + B
否定同级比较：A + be/动词 + not as/so + 形容词/副词原级 + as + B
疑问同级比较：Be/助动词/情态动词 + A + as + 形容词/副词原级 + as + B?
比较级：A + be/动词 + 形容词/副词比较级 + than + B
最高级：A + be/动词 + the + 形容词/副词最高级 + 比较范围
倍数比较：A + be + 倍数 + as + 形容词/副词原级 + as + B
notes: as…as 中间必须用形容词或副词的原级，不能受汉语“更”的影响而误用比较级。
在高考书面表达中，使用“倍数 + as…as”或“as + 形容词 + a/an + 名词 + as”能提升句式层次，但要注意名词单复数和冠词位置。
比较对象必须对等：比较天气时，应写“The weather in Beijing is colder than that in Shanghai”，用 that 指代前面的 weather，避免逻辑错误。
not so…as 在口语中更自然，not as…as 在正式书面语中更稳妥；高考写作中建议优先使用 not as…as。
注意不规则比较等级：well 的比较级是 better 而不是 more well；far 有两种比较级 farther（指距离更远）和 further（指程度更进一步），在书面语中需根据语境选择。

examples.en: The south wind is as warm as the summer breeze.
examples.cn: 南风温暖如夏日的微风。

examples.en: This winter is not as cold as last winter.
examples.cn: 这个冬天不如去年冬天冷。

examples.en: Is the weather in spring as changeable as people say?
examples.cn: 春天的天气真的像人们说的那样多变吗？

examples.en: The climate in the south is much warmer than that in the north.
examples.cn: 南方的气候比北方的气候温暖得多。

examples.en: This region receives twice as much rainfall as the national average.
examples.cn: 该地区的降雨量是全国平均水平的两倍。

examples.en: It was as challenging a journey as any we had ever undertaken.
examples.cn: 这是一次与我们以往经历过的任何旅程同样具有挑战性的旅行。

exercises.q: My schoolbag is ______ yours. They are both 5 kg.
exercises.explain: as...as...中间必须用形容词原级，表示“和……一样重”。

exercises.q: Tom runs ______ his brother. They both finish in 12 seconds.
exercises.explain: 同级比较用 as + 副词原级 + as，表示“跑得一样快”。

exercises.q: This film is not ______ that one. It is boring.
exercises.explain: 否定同级比较用 not as + 形容词原级 + as，表示“不如……有趣”。

exercises.q: The weather in Kunming is ______ in Beijing in winter.
exercises.explain: 两者比较且有差异时用比较级，warm 的比较级是 warmer。

exercises.q: Lily sings ______ Lucy. They both sing very well.
exercises.explain: 修饰动词 sings 要用副词 well，同级比较为 as well as。

exercises.q: My sister is ______ tall as my mother now.
exercises.explain: as + 形容词原级 + as 是同级比较结构，第一个空填 as。

exercises.q: This question is not ______ difficult as that one.
exercises.explain: 否定形式 not as/so...as... 中第二个 as 前可填 as 或 so，此处填 as。

exercises.q: He runs as ______ (fast) as a horse.
exercises.explain: as...as...中间必须用副词原级 fast。

exercises.q: The sentence "My bag is as heavier as yours" is correct.
exercises.explain: as...as...中间不能用比较级 heavier，必须用原级 heavy。

exercises.q: The sentence "This book is not as interesting as that one" means this book is less interesting.
exercises.explain: not as...as... 表示“不如……”，即这本书不如那本有趣。

exercises.q: Tom is 12 years old. Jack is 12 years old too. (用 as...as... 合并句子)
exercises.answer: Tom is as old as Jack.
exercises.explain: 年龄相同用 as + 形容词原级 + as 表示同级比较。

exercises.q: This room is bigger than that one. (改为否定句，用 not as...as...)
exercises.answer: That room is not as big as this one.
exercises.explain: 否定同级比较需调换比较对象，用 not as + 原级 + as。

exercises.q: She speaks English well. I speak English well too. (用 as...as... 合并)
exercises.answer: She speaks English as well as I do.
exercises.explain: 副词同级比较用 as + 副词原级 + as，句末可用 do 代替重复动词。

exercises.q: This apple is as sweeter as that one.
exercises.answer: This apple is as sweet as that one.
exercises.explain: as...as...中间必须用形容词原级 sweet，不能用 sweeter。

exercises.q: He doesn't run as fast than his friend.
exercises.answer: He doesn't run as fast as his friend.
exercises.explain: 同级比较否定形式是 not as...as...，不能用 than。

exercises.q: The new library is ______ the old one, but it has more books.
exercises.explain: 后半句有转折，说明新图书馆不如旧的大，用 not as + 原级 + as。

exercises.q: He can run ______ I can. We are both fast.
exercises.explain: 副词同级比较用 as + 副词原级 + as，quickly 是原级。

exercises.q: This math problem is ______ that one. I can't solve either of them.
exercises.explain: 两个都解不出来，说明难度相同，用 as + 原级 + as。

exercises.q: My sister is ______ me. She always gets higher scores.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词比较级用 more + 原级 + than，表示“比……更努力”。

exercises.q: The weather today is ______ yesterday. It's much colder.
exercises.explain: 今天更冷，说明不如昨天暖和，用 not as + 原级 + as。

exercises.q: This story is not so ______ (exciting) as that one.
exercises.explain: not so...as... 中间用形容词原级 exciting。

exercises.q: He speaks English as ______ (clear) as his teacher.
exercises.explain: 修饰动词 speaks 要用副词 clearly，as...as... 中间用副词原级。

exercises.q: The film was not ______ interesting as we expected.
exercises.explain: 否定同级比较 not as...as... 中第二个 as 前填 as。

exercises.q: The sentence "She is as more careful as her sister" is correct.
exercises.explain: as...as... 中间不能用 more，必须用原级 careful。

exercises.q: The sentence "This task is not as easy as I thought" means the task is harder than expected.
exercises.explain: not as easy as 表示“不如想的容易”，即更难。

exercises.q: This book is more interesting than that one. (用 not as...as... 改写，保持意思不变)
exercises.answer: That book is not as interesting as this one.
exercises.explain: 比较级与否定同级比较可互换，需调换主语。

exercises.q: He is the tallest boy in his class. (用 as...as... 改写，保持意思相近)
exercises.answer: No other boy in his class is as tall as him.
exercises.explain: 最高级可转换为“没有其他人像他一样高”的同级比较否定形式。

exercises.q: My father drives carefully. My mother drives carefully too. (用 as...as... 合并)
exercises.answer: My father drives as carefully as my mother does.
exercises.explain: 副词同级比较用 as + 副词原级 + as，句末用 does 代替重复动词。

exercises.q: This city is not as cleaner as that one.
exercises.answer: This city is not as clean as that one.
exercises.explain: as...as... 中间必须用原级 clean，不能用比较级 cleaner。

exercises.q: She doesn't sing as better as her sister.
exercises.answer: She doesn't sing as well as her sister.
exercises.explain: 修饰动词 sing 要用副词原级 well，不能用 better。

exercises.q: The situation is ______ we expected. We need to change our plan.
exercises.explain: 需要改变计划说明情况不如预期的简单，用 not as + 原级 + as。

exercises.q: He speaks English ______ a native speaker, though he has never been abroad.
exercises.explain: 修饰动词 speaks 用副词 fluently，同级比较用 as + 副词原级 + as。

exercises.q: The more you practice, ______ you will become.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 表示“越……越……”，是比较结构的特殊用法。

exercises.q: This problem is ______ that one. Both require careful thinking.
exercises.explain: 两者都需要仔细思考，说明难度相同，用 as + 原级 + as。

exercises.q: Among all the subjects, I find physics ______ to learn.
exercises.explain: among all 表示三者以上比较，用最高级 the most difficult。

exercises.q: The result was not as ______ (satisfy) as we had hoped.
exercises.explain: as...as... 中间用形容词原级，satisfy 的形容词形式是 satisfying。

exercises.q: She explained the problem as ______ (clear) as possible.
exercises.explain: 修饰动词 explained 用副词 clearly，as...as possible 表示“尽可能……”。

exercises.q: The gap between the rich and the poor is becoming ______ (wide) than before.
exercises.explain: 有 than before 表示比较，用比较级 wider。

exercises.q: The sentence "He is as good a student as his brother" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: as + 形容词 + a/an + 名词 + as 是同级比较的正式结构，语法正确。

exercises.q: The sentence "This is not as an interesting book as that one" is correct.
exercises.explain: 正确结构是 not as interesting a book as，冠词应放在形容词之后。

exercises.q: No other mountain in the world is as high as Mount Qomolangma. (用最高级改写)
exercises.answer: Mount Qomolangma is the highest mountain in the world.
exercises.explain: 同级比较否定形式可转换为最高级，表示“珠穆朗玛峰是世界上最高的山”。

exercises.q: He is less hard-working than his sister. (用 not as...as... 改写)
exercises.answer: He is not as hard-working as his sister.
exercises.explain: less + 原级 + than 可转换为 not as + 原级 + as。

exercises.q: The more you read, the more you know. (保持意思，用 as...as... 改写为否定形式)
exercises.answer: If you don't read as much, you won't know as much.
exercises.explain: the more...the more 结构可转换为条件句加同级比较否定形式。

exercises.q: This is as a difficult problem as that one.
exercises.answer: This is as difficult a problem as that one.
exercises.explain: as + 形容词 + a/an + 名词 + as 结构中，冠词应放在形容词之后。

exercises.q: The more you practice, the best you will become.
exercises.answer: The more you practice, the better you will become.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 结构中两个比较级要对应，best 应改为 better。

exercises.q: The weather in Kunming is usually as ______ as spring all year round.
exercises.explain: as...as... 中间必须用形容词原级。

exercises.q: My younger brother is not ______ tall as me.
exercises.explain: not as...as... 是同级比较的否定形式，第一个 as 不能省略。

exercises.q: This book is ______ interesting as the one I read last week.
exercises.explain: as + 形容词原级 + as 表示"和……一样……"。

exercises.q: Tom runs ______ faster than Jim.
exercises.explain: much 可以修饰比较级 faster，表示"快得多"。

exercises.q: The white shirt is ______ cheaper than the blue one.
exercises.explain: a little 可以修饰比较级 cheaper，表示"便宜一点"。

exercises.q: The weather in Hainan is not as ______ (cold) as that in Beijing.
exercises.explain: not as...as... 中间用形容词原级。

exercises.q: Lucy sings as ______ (well) as her sister.
exercises.explain: as...as... 中间用副词原级修饰动词 sings。

exercises.q: This question is ______ (easy) than that one.
exercises.explain: than 提示用比较级，easy 变 y 为 i 加 er。

exercises.q: The sentence "This box is as heavier as that one." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: as...as... 中间必须用原级，不能用比较级 heavier。

exercises.q: The sentence "My bag is not so big as yours." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: not so...as... 是 not as...as... 的变体，表示"不如……"。

exercises.q: This room is as big as that one. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: This room is not as/so big as that one.
exercises.explain: 同级比较的否定形式在第一个 as 前加 not，也可用 not so...as...。

exercises.q: The red car is not as expensive as the black car. (改为肯定句)
exercises.answer: The red car is as expensive as the black car.
exercises.explain: 去掉 not 即可恢复为肯定同级比较。

exercises.q: He is taller than me. (用 not as...as... 改写，保持句意基本不变)
exercises.answer: I am not as/so tall as him.
exercises.explain: 用 not as...as... 从"我"的角度表达"不如他高"。

exercises.q: This film is as more interesting as that one.
exercises.answer: This film is as interesting as that one.
exercises.explain: as...as... 中间必须用原级，去掉 more。

exercises.q: She doesn't run as faster as her brother.
exercises.answer: She doesn't run as fast as her brother.
exercises.explain: as...as... 中间用副词原级 fast，不用 faster。

exercises.q: The new stadium is twice ______ large as the old one.
exercises.explain: 倍数表达法：倍数 + as + 原级 + as。

exercises.q: I don't think this novel is ______ interesting as the one you recommended.
exercises.explain: not as...as... 表示"不如……"，中间用原级。

exercises.q: The more you practice, the ______ you will become.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 表示"越……越……"。

exercises.q: His spoken English is not ______ fluent as his written English.
exercises.explain: not as + 原级 + as 是同级比较的否定形式。

exercises.q: This task is far ______ difficult than I expected.
exercises.explain: far 修饰比较级 more difficult，表示"难得多"。

exercises.q: The population of China is much ______ (large) than that of Japan.
exercises.explain: than 提示用比较级，much 修饰比较级。

exercises.q: She speaks English as ______ (fluently) as a native speaker.
exercises.explain: as...as... 中间用副词原级修饰动词 speaks。

exercises.q: The weather today is even ______ (bad) than yesterday.
exercises.explain: bad 的比较级是不规则变化 worse。

exercises.q: The sentence "This mountain is three times as high as that hill." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: 倍数 + as + 原级 + as 是标准倍数表达法。

exercises.q: The sentence "The more you read, the more you know." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 结构表示"越……越……"。

exercises.q: This book is less interesting than that one. (用 not as...as... 改写)
exercises.answer: This book is not as/so interesting as that one.
exercises.explain: less...than... 与 not as...as... 可互换表示"不如……"。

exercises.q: The Yangtze River is longer than the Yellow River. (用 not as...as... 改写，以 the Yellow River 作主语)
exercises.answer: The Yellow River is not as/so long as the Yangtze River.
exercises.explain: 转换比较对象后，用 not as...as... 表达"不如……长"。

exercises.q: No other student in the class is as tall as Mike. (用比较级改写，保持句意不变)
exercises.answer: Mike is taller than any other student in the class.
exercises.explain: 否定同级比较可转换为比较级最高级含义。

exercises.q: The situation is getting more and more worse.
exercises.answer: The situation is getting worse and worse.
exercises.explain: 比较级 + and + 比较级 表示"越来越……"，worse 本身已是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: This problem is not as easier as the previous one.
exercises.answer: This problem is not as easy as the previous one.
exercises.explain: as...as... 中间必须用原级 easy，不能用比较级 easier。

exercises.q: The more carefully you examine the data, the ______ conclusions you will draw.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 结构，此处用 more reliable 修饰 conclusions。

exercises.q: Rarely has a scientific discovery been ______ controversial as the one announced last week.
exercises.explain: as + 形容词原级 + as 用于同级比较，此处为倒装句中的同级比较。

exercises.q: The new software is not ______ user-friendly as the developers claimed.
exercises.explain: not as...as... 表示"不如……"，中间用原级。

exercises.q: He is ______ a talented musician as his mentor, if not more so.
exercises.explain: as much a + 单数名词 + as 是同级比较的特殊结构。

exercises.q: The gap between the rich and the poor is becoming ______ wide as the economy grows.
exercises.explain: increasingly 修饰形容词 wide，表示"越来越……"，此处不构成 as...as... 结构。

exercises.q: The results of the experiment were not as ______ (convince) as the researchers had expected.
exercises.explain: as...as... 中间用形容词原级 convincing，表示"有说服力的"。

exercises.q: She handled the crisis as ______ (calm) as anyone could have done.
exercises.explain: as...as... 中间用副词原级 calmly 修饰动词 handled。

exercises.q: The more you understand the context, the ______ (little) likely you are to misjudge the situation.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 结构，little 的比较级是 less。

exercises.q: The sentence "He is as brilliant a scholar as any in his field." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: as + 形容词 + a/an + 名词 + as 是同级比较的正式结构。

exercises.q: The sentence "The more complex the problem is, the more time it will take to solve it." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 结构使用正确。

exercises.q: No other novel in the 20th century is as influential as Ulysses. (用比较级改写，保持句意不变)
exercises.answer: Ulysses is more influential than any other novel in the 20th century.
exercises.explain: 否定同级比较可转换为比较级表达最高级含义。

exercises.q: The new policy is not as effective as the previous one. (用 less...than... 改写)
exercises.answer: The new policy is less effective than the previous one.
exercises.explain: not as...as... 与 less...than... 可互换表示"不如……"。

exercises.q: He is as talented a writer as his father was. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: He is not as/so talented a writer as his father was.
exercises.explain: 在 as...as... 结构前加 not 构成否定，注意语序不变。

exercises.q: The more you ignore the problem, the worst it will become.
exercises.answer: The more you ignore the problem, the worse it will become.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 结构中，后半句也必须用比较级 worse。

exercises.q: Her performance was not as impressively as the judges had anticipated.
exercises.answer: Her performance was not as impressive as the judges had anticipated.
exercises.explain: as...as... 中间用形容词原级 impressive 作表语，不用副词 impressively。
